chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Jaʿfar ibn Bashīr, from Nuʿmān al-Rāzī, who said:

I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, and Abū ʿUbaydah al-Ḥadhdhāʾ asked him about the case of a man who forgot to give the adhan and iqamah until he pronounced the takbir and entered into the salat (prayer).
He عليه السلام said: “If he entered the masjid while intending to give the adhan and iqamah, then let him continue in his salat (prayer) and not turn away.”

key_terms.وَلَا يَنْصَرِفْ: and let him not turn away or leave
key_terms.يُؤَذِّنَ: to give the adhan, the call to prayer
key_terms.يُقِيمَ: to give the iqamah, the commencement call before prayer

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he forgot the adhan and iqamah until after starting salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who forgot the adhan and iqamah until after beginning the salat (prayer). If he had originally intended to perform them before the prayer, then he should continue his prayer and not leave it.
